evals.name: seal-commit-style
evals.prompt:
Seal the [Unreleased] section of CHANGELOG.md into version 1.4.0 for release today (2026-07-25). Rewrite commit-style entries into Keep a Changelog release notes, drop internal-only noise, fix bare issue links, update footer compare links. Do not bump any other version files — only CHANGELOG.md.

Merged PRs since 2026-06-01 (for linking):
#41 Fix path normalization for cache keys
#42 Widget result cache and cache: true config
#43 CLI --json for widget list
(no PR for pure internal docs refactor)
evals.expected_output: CHANGELOG.md with empty [Unreleased], new ## [1.4.0] - 2026-07-25 section with release-style one-line bullets, full markdown PR links, no hard-wrapped prose, footer compare links for Unreleased and 1.4.0
assertions: Output CHANGELOG has ## [1.4.0] - 2026-07-25 (or equivalent ISO date) below [Unreleased]
[Unreleased] section has no leftover release bullets (empty or only deferred items)
No bare #N references; PR links use full markdown form where a PR exists
Internal-only WidgetCache refactor is absent from the sealed section
Every bullet and summary paragraph is one physical line (no mid-sentence hard wrap)
Footer has [Unreleased] compare from v1.4.0...HEAD and [1.4.0] compare from previous tag
Top-level bullets are user-facing release style, not commit-message prose like 'Fix normalize_path'

evals.name: empty-unreleased-from-prs
evals.prompt:
CHANGELOG.md has an empty [Unreleased]. Write release 2.1.0 dated 2026-07-25 from these merged PRs only (no other files). Seal into Keep a Changelog form with user-facing bullets, full markdown links, one physical line per prose block, and updated footer compare links.

Merged since 2026-05-15:
#91 Add OAuth device-code login flow
#92 Fix refresh token rotation race under concurrent requests
#93 Internal: rename AuthService methods for clarity (no behavior change)
#94 Deprecate password grant; still works with a warning
evals.expected_output: CHANGELOG with [2.1.0] section covering Added/Fixed/Deprecated as appropriate; #93 omitted as internal; footer links updated
assertions: New ## [2.1.0] - 2026-07-25 section exists
OAuth device-code login appears under Added (or equivalent user-facing wording)
Refresh token race fix appears under Fixed
Password grant deprecation appears under Deprecated
Internal AuthService rename (#93) has no user-facing entry
PR links are full markdown URLs to github.com/acme/authkit
No hard-wrapped prose in bullets or summary
Footer [Unreleased] points at v2.1.0...HEAD

evals.name: mid-cycle-append
evals.prompt: Do not cut a release. Append a release-style [Unreleased] entry for PR #15: 'Add XLSX export with shared styles'. Full link https://github.com/acme/sheetly/pull/15. Keep existing entries. One physical line per bullet. Only edit CHANGELOG.md.
evals.expected_output: CHANGELOG still at [Unreleased] only for new work; new Added bullet for XLSX export with full PR link; version 0.9.0 section unchanged; no new version heading
assertions: No new ## [x.y.z] version heading was added
### Added exists under [Unreleased] with an XLSX export bullet
New bullet includes full markdown link to pull/15
Existing Fixed entry about timezone is still present
New bullet is one physical line
Footer compare links unchanged (still v0.9.0)
